name: Alessia Fontana
bio:
Alessia Fontana's passion for motorsport ignited during her childhood in Modena, the heart of Italy's automotive industry. She pursued her engineering degree at the University of Bologna, specializing in advanced electrical systems. After graduating, Alessia worked for a local racing team, gaining invaluable experience in developing and maintaining the complex electronics of racing cars. Her meticulous approach and problem-solving skills quickly made her an indispensable member of the team. 

Alessia joined Aston Martin five years ago, where she has become known for her unwavering commitment to performance. She approaches her work with a relentless focus on precision and efficiency, always striving to optimize the electronic systems for maximum speed and reliability. While demanding, Alessia is respected by her colleagues for her deep knowledge and willingness to share her expertise, fostering a culture of excellence within the team. Her sharp eye for detail and unwavering dedication have made her a crucial asset to Aston Martin's racing program.

 Her leadership and troubleshooting skills have been instrumental to Aston Martin, giving her a solid reputation within the team. She thrives under pressure and has proven time and again her ability to deliver when the stakes are high.
